fair_value.method: Blend of a pro-forma sum-of-the-parts (~$8.0/share on 331M shares and ~$0.885B net claims at the VAC close), a discounted 2028 EV/EBITDA (~$7.2/share, with the VAC ramp slowed), and a 50% haircut to the ~$24 sell-side consensus ($12), weighted 0.5/0.3/0.2. That gives ~$8.6; I add ~$0.5 for the policy scarcity premium on US mine-to-magnet assets, for $9.1.

methods.name: SOTP
methods.inputs: 331M basic shares pro forma (249.965M at 7/31/26 + ~14.8M ASM + 65.853M VAC). Segment EVs: uranium $1.2B (~2M lb/yr at ~$23/lb cost against ~$85 realized, spot ~$90, ~$120M EBITDA x 10x). Vara Mada $0.45B ($1.8B NPV risked 25%). Donald $0.2B: 49% of Phase 1 pre-tax NPV8 A$759M, risked 50% for tax and a pre-FID stage (~$0.12B), plus 49% of Phase 2 A$1.5B risked ~15% (~$0.08B). White Mesa heavy REE Phase 1 $0.15B plus Phase 2 NdPr option $0.4B. VAC $1.3B (~17x a mid-range $75M 2027 EBITDA against $60-90M; Sumter run-rate $65-75M at 2,000 tpa). ASM $0.14B. Corporate G&A -$0.3B. EV ~$3.54B less net claims ~$0.885B (~$0.75B net debt at close: $936.7M cash+securities at 6/30 - $718M VAC cash - ~$24M ASM cash - ~$100M burn/capex, against $700M converts and $140M VAC net debt; plus ~$135M Ara preferred) = equity ~$2.66B / 331M = ~$8.0.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: 2028E pro-forma EBITDA ~$215M (uranium $130M + VAC $95M, since Sumter is at 2,000 tpa with 4,000 tpa unproven by 2028 + heavy REE $40M - corporate $50M) x 18x strategic-minerals multiple = $3.87B EV, discounted 1 yr at 12% = $3.46B; less ~$1.0B net claims after 2027 capex (Phase 1B/1C, Donald earn-in; the OSC loan is net-debt neutral if drawn) = $2.46B / ~340M shares (allowing ATM/equity issuance if OSC fails) = ~$7.2.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Sell-side consensus 12-month target ~$24 (Cantor Buy Sept 4, 2026; H.C. Wainwright $29.25 Sept 1), haircut 50%. These targets assume full REE execution, and Zacks consensus 2027 EPS is only ~$0.03.

bear.story: The US-China thaw after the Sept 24 Trump-Xi summit erodes the rare earth premium. The OSC $725M loan is not finalized (it is still a conditional commitment), so the White Mesa and metals-plant capex has to be funded by ATM or discounted equity on top of the 65.85M VAC shares and a full $135M preferred. The VAC Sumter ramp lags, Donald FID keeps slipping, Vara Mada stalls, uranium drifts to the low $70s, and losses persist through 2027.

base.story: Uranium holds around $85-95/lb with ~2M lb/yr at ~$23/lb. VAC closes in 2027-Q1 with ~$0.75B net debt plus the preferred, and VAC runs at $60-90M EBITDA in 2027. The OSC loan is finalized in some form during 2027, Donald reaches FID late, Tb/Dy circuits approach commissioning around end-2027, and dilution is modest. The stock trades a little above a ~$9 fundamental value, carried by strategic optionality.

bull.story: A renewed Chinese export squeeze or a US policy push (OSC loan finalized, offtakes, price floors) re-rates Western mine-to-magnet names. VAC Sumter ramps toward 4,000 tpa, the Japanese Tb qualification converts into contracts, Donald FID and Vara Mada fiscal terms land, and uranium goes above $100. The stock heads back toward the ~$20-24 consensus.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$6.30 the equity would be ~$2.09B on 331M shares, which plus ~$0.885B net claims is an EV of ~$2.97B. That is roughly uranium plus VAC at a discount to the price paid, with almost nothing for White Mesa REE, Donald, Vara Mada or ASM. A move there would most likely mean something fundamental broke rather than ordinary 89%-vol noise: the VAC close failed or was renegotiated, the OSC loan fell through and forced a large discounted equity raise, Madagascar reversed Vara Mada terms, or uranium fell below ~$65/lb.

reasoning: Round 2. The supervisor confirmed my ~331M pro-forma share count and put net claims at the close at ~$0.75B net debt plus ~$135M preferred (~$0.885B), close to my $0.84B. I rebuilt it from the verified $936.7M 6/30 cash+securities rather than my '~$850M YE26 liquidity'. I verified that the OSC $725M loan is still only a conditional commitment (no definitive agreement announced) and that it funds White Mesa and the metals plant, not the VAC cash leg. So I treat it as net-debt neutral and raised the bear-case weight for an equity raise if it fails (0.30 to 0.32). I verified the Donald economics: Phase 1 pre-tax NPV8 A$759M and Phase 2 A$1.5B (combined A$2.3B). My round-1 Donald value covered only Phase 1, so I added a heavily risked Phase 2 sliver (+~$0.08B), because FID has slipped from Q2 to Q3 2026 and was still not announced by 9/25. I accepted the supervisor's point that 4,000 tpa at Sumter by 2028 is unproven. I cut 2028 VAC EBITDA from $120M to ~$95M and trimmed the VAC SOTP value from $1.4B to $1.3B (~17x a $75M midpoint of $60-90M for 2027). Net effect: SOTP $8.2 to $8.0, EV/EBITDA $8.4 to $7.2, consensus-haircut unchanged at $12, blended ~$8.6 plus ~$0.5 scarcity premium = $9.1 (from $9.5). New evidence that supports the current value: uranium spot is steady at ~$90 (up ~20% y/y), Tb oxide has been qualified by a major Japanese magnet maker, the Donald REEC export licence to the US was granted, and brokers reiterated Buy ratings in early September. I agree with the supervisor that these corrections are small relative to 70-90% volatility. I moved my lognormal median only from ~$10.8 to ~$10.6 (σ≈0.75) and kept it above fair value because of thematic optionality and the liquid-asset and uranium floor. I kept the thinned far-left tail (P≥$4.54 ≈ 0.885) and trimmed the far-right tail slightly (P≥$28 from 0.09 to 0.085) for the dilution overhang. P(close≥$11.35) is 0.458 (from 0.47). The scenario EV is ≈ $11.8 against a median ≈ $10.6, consistent with right skew. About 7 more searches were used in round 2. No option data or priors were used.
